title: Duplicate keys cause earlier TypedDict values to be skipped during type checking
author: Hmanbo
body_preview: **Bug Report**  When a dictionary literal used to construct a `TypedDict` contains duplicate keys, mypy only type-checks the final value for that key. Earlier value expressions are skipped entirely.  This can hide real errors because Python still evaluates every value expression in the dictionary literal, including values that are later overwritten by a duplicate key.  **To Reproduce**...
